hero.emptyProjects: No projects yet. Add them from the admin panel.

admin.loginHint: Use password and 2FA to access the dashboard
admin.backgroundSettingsHint: Manage homepage backgrounds, theme-specific image lists, video source and slideshow interval here.
admin.dashboardDesc: What is live right now, plus the usual shortcuts.
admin.siteDesc: Site name, logo, GitHub profile, and the zh/en homepage copy plus social cards.
admin.appearanceDesc: Page palette, light/dark themes, layout density and homepage section order.
admin.backgroundDesc: Hero image/video, per-theme image sets, slideshow interval, overlay and crop.
admin.projectsDesc: Create and edit project cards: cover, links, bilingual copy and tech stack.
admin.linksDesc: Maintain friend links and contact links, with ordering and visibility.
admin.securityDesc: Two-factor authentication (TOTP), recovery codes and the login password.
admin.quickStartHint: Any row jumps straight to that screen.
admin.twoFactorOnHint: Signing in requires the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.twoFactorOffHint: The password alone still opens this console. Enable two-factor now.
admin.authAsideBody: Manage the site copy, projects, links and hero media here. Every change is written straight to the database — refresh the public site to see it.
admin.authPointContent: Edit site copy, projects and links online
admin.authPointAppearance: Page palette, hero media and cropping
admin.authPointSecurity: Protected by password and TOTP two-factor
admin.brandSectionHint: The site name appears in the title, footer and share cards. The logo can be a link or an upload.
admin.logoModeHint: Use an external URL or upload an image to this site.
admin.contentSectionHint: Chinese and English are maintained separately; empty fields fall back to the built-in defaults.
admin.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check the file format and your connection, then retry.
admin.loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check the email and password.
admin.slugHint: Used in project links and ordering. Lowercase words with dashes, e.g. my-project.
admin.projectFormHint: Fill in the project basics and the copy for both languages.
admin.projectsListHint: Ordered by featured flag, sort order and creation time.
admin.emptyProjectsHint: Use “New project” above, or fill in the form and save.
admin.isFeaturedHint: Featured projects sort first and are marked on the public site.
admin.isPublishedHint: Unchecked keeps it hidden from the public site.
admin.techStackHint: Comma separated, e.g. Next.js, Prisma, SQLite
admin.linkFormHint: The name and icon are what visitors see; the URL is where the row links to.
admin.friendLinksListHint: Friend links show on the friends page; lower sort order comes first.
admin.contactLinksListHint: Contact links show in the homepage contact section.
admin.emptyFriendLinksHint: Fill in a name and URL on the right, then save.
admin.emptyContactLinksHint: Fill in a name and icon on the right, then save.
admin.scanQrHint: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, …), then enter the 6-digit code to finish.
admin.copyFailed: Copy failed — please write the recovery codes down manually.
admin.metaTitleHint: Text shown in the browser tab. Falls back to the site name when left empty.
admin.accentColorHint: Use a hex color like #4cc9ff. It controls the glow accents and futuristic highlight color on the page.
admin.gradientModeHint: Choose whether the homepage base layer uses a single accent color or a linear gradient.
admin.showFriendLinksHint: When disabled, the homepage entry is hidden while the dedicated friend-links page remains available.
admin.gradientStartHint: The first gradient color, for example #1297ff.
admin.gradientEndHint: The second gradient color, for example #7b61ff.
admin.gradientAngleHint: Measured in degrees from 0-360. Common values like 90, 135 and 180 change the gradient direction.
admin.heroMediaTypeHint: Choose whether the homepage background uses an image slideshow or a looping video.
admin.heroEffectHint: Controls how strongly the background moves while scrolling. Scroll pan is subtle, parallax is stronger.
admin.heroMediaUrlHint: This is the default media URL. In image mode it can be the first slide, in video mode it is the video source.
admin.heroPosterUrlHint: Used only for video backgrounds. This image is shown before the video finishes loading.
admin.heroBackgroundPositionHint: Choose which part of the background shows when it is cropped. Click a cell in the 3×3 grid.
admin.heroBackgroundRectHint: Drag the box to move it, drag the corner handle to resize; the box marks exactly the hero region that stays visible.
admin.heroBackgroundRectNoImage: Enter a background image URL first
admin.heroBackgroundRectPerImageHint: Each hero background image can have its own crop region (drag to move, drag the corner to resize); light and dark mode images are configured separately.
admin.heroOverlayOpacityHint: Range 0-90. Higher values darken the background more so foreground text is easier to read.
admin.heroIntervalHint: Measured in milliseconds. 4500 means one slide every 4.5 seconds. 1000 ms = 1 second.
admin.heroPlaylistPlaceholder: One background image URL per line for sequential playback
admin.heroPlaylistHint: When the hero uses images, this list is played in sequence. Uploaded images are appended here automatically.
admin.lightHeroImageUrl: Light theme primary background image URL
admin.lightHeroImageUrlHint: The first preferred background image for light mode.
admin.lightHeroPlaylist: Light theme background image list, one URL per line
admin.lightHeroPlaylistHint: Used only in light mode. One image URL per line, played in order.
admin.darkHeroImageUrl: Dark theme primary background image URL
admin.darkHeroImageUrlHint: The first preferred background image for dark mode.
admin.darkHeroPlaylist: Dark theme background image list, one URL per line
admin.darkHeroPlaylistHint: Used only in dark mode. One image URL per line, played in order.
admin.themePlaylistHint: Light and dark modes can use different image lists. Empty fields fall back to the shared background list.
admin.heroUploadHint: Upload a shared background asset here. The uploaded file is added to the URL field or playlist automatically.
admin.darkHeroUploadHint: Upload dark-mode-only background images here. They will be appended to the dark playlist.
admin.lightHeroUploadHint: Upload light-mode-only background images here. They will be appended to the light playlist.
admin.headline: Headline
admin.footerTextHint: The small text at the bottom of the page. Configurable per locale; falls back to the built-in default when empty.
admin.footerTextPlaceholder: For example: xh.do : an evolving personal digital space
admin.title: Title
admin.sortOrderHint: Display weight — lower numbers appear first. 0 is the default (top of the list); use larger numbers (e.g. 10, 20) to push items lower.
admin.twoFactorDescription: Use your current password to enable or disable QR-code based TOTP verification.
admin.backupCodesHint: Store these recovery codes offline in case you lose access to your authenticator app.
admin.qrReady: QR code is ready. Scan it and enter the code to finish setup.
admin.dashboardIntro: Manage homepage copy, logo, background image playback or video, and project content here. Changes are written directly to the database and reflected on the public site without redeploying.
admin.twoFactorPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.changePasswordHint: Enable 2FA first, then replace the bootstrap placeholder password with a strong password (>= 12 chars). All other active sessions will be signed out.
admin.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 12 characters.
admin.passwordMismatch: The two new-password fields do not match.
admin.passwordSameAsCurrent: New password must differ from the current one.
admin.passwordChanged: Password updated. All other sessions have been signed out.
admin.seoHint: These fields control browser tab title, search-engine summary, and social share previews. Leave blank to fall back to the hero headline and subheadline.
admin.metaDescriptionHint: Search engines usually truncate at ~160 characters.
admin.metaDescriptionPlaceholder: One-line summary of the site, used in search results…
admin.ogImageUrlHint: Leave blank for the default gradient. Set an image URL or upload below to use it as the preview background with the site title layered on top (1200x630 or wider landscape recommended; PNG/JPG/WebP supported).
admin.ogImageUrlUploadHint: Uploaded images become the auto-generated preview background (auto-darkened, title text on top). You can also paste an external image URL above.
admin.twitterHandleHint: Shown on the Twitter card as @handle.
admin.ogTitlePlaceholder: Blank falls back to page title
admin.ogDescriptionPlaceholder: Blank falls back to meta description
admin.twitterTitlePlaceholder: Blank falls back to page title
admin.twitterDescriptionPlaceholder: Blank falls back to meta description
admin.emptyContactLinks: No contact links yet. Add one on the right.

noscript.title: JavaScript is required
noscript.description: This site relies on JavaScript for animations, theme switching and the admin tools. Please enable JavaScript in your browser settings and reload this page. Static content remains readable, but some features will not work.

appearance.title: Appearance & page background
appearance.intro: Hero media now sits behind the entire page, with image-adaptive components. Manual colors provide overrides and safe fallbacks; independent backgrounds still support solids, gradients and images.
appearance.heroSettings: Manage hero wallpaper, video, overlay & crop
appearance.imageHint: Root-relative or HTTP(S) image URL. HTTPS is recommended online. PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF, up to 50 MB. No full-page video.
appearance.sectionsHint: Reorder with arrows, uncheck to hide. Hidden sections also leave the navigation. Empty contact sections are omitted.
appearance.previewHint: Save and visit the homepage to see automatic colors and the full-page hero image.
appearance.saved: Saved. Public-page caches usually refresh after about a minute. Please refresh later.
appearance.uploaded: Image uploaded. Save appearance to apply it.
appearance.uploadInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or AVIF image under 50 MB.
appearance.uploadFailed: Upload failed. Check your session, image format and connection, then retry.
appearance.saveFailed: Could not save. Your inputs are retained. Check your connection or other site settings and retry.
appearance.unauthorized: Your session expired or two-factor verification is required. Sign in and complete verification, then retry.
appearance.autoColors: Adapt colors to the current hero image
appearance.adaptiveHint: Automatic colors follow the active image. Disable to use manual colors below; these also serve as fallback if sampling fails. Videos use their poster.
